$comment: Targets for the case-name lookup suite. Target ids are the identifier used by the CLI (--target), the container (BENCHMARK_CONFIG), the published bundle directory, and the latest.json key. public-8850 is the headline target: 15 categories, 295 paired cases each, one perturbed row and one control row per case. negatives-50 is the invariant population -- fabricated case names that resolve to no document -- reported separately from the headline by construction.
title: TrustFoundry Case-Name Lookup
